reviews.summary: Server 0.10.4 preserves player 0.10.3 sync, playlist schema 1, and same-origin APK update metadata; GitHub source adds verified mirroring only. 152 Node, 89 Python and 13 native Java tests plus landing/download browser checks pass; physical TV upgrade acceptance remains pending.

Corrects the prior Android enrollment review: new registration returns HTTP 201, which player 0.10.3 rejected. Player 0.10.4 now pairs with the existing server API; direct GitHub updates remove dependence on server APK routes while preserving optional server source and metadata schema. 25 native tests include real Express enrollment/restart/approval; 152 Node and 89 Python tests pass. Physical TV installation remains pending.

Player 0.10.5 adds a persisted per-device automatic-update setting that defaults off; manual checks remain available and APK source selection, package identity, signatures, sync protocol, and server contracts are unchanged.

Server refreshes slide snapshots in existing playlist manifests, can copy slide audience grants to uploaded assets, and converts GIFs to animated WebP; player sync and manifest schema 1 remain unchanged.
Add playlist sharing confirmation without changing player APIs
Add playlist access preflight and sharing confirmation; player contract unchanged
Playlist manifests can now contain downloadable font assets; updated Pi and Android players cache and render them
Custom fonts are added as playlist assets; player 0.10.6 adds font download, caching, and rendering
Slide save now clamps edge-aligned dimensions and positions; playlist and player contracts unchanged

Server 0.14.1 publishes manifest schema 2 for removed-media placeholders; player 0.10.7 or newer is required before deleting media used by published slides; updated players continue to accept schema 1
Add nested folders and published-playlist metadata without changing player protocol
Android and Pi agents now accept playlist schema 2 used for removed-media placeholders; schema 1 remains supported
